Package run turns a JSON scenario into a deterministic simulation and\n// produces a JSON report.\n//\n// A scenario declares nodes, their initial data, link fault profiles, the\n// protocol config, a schedule of client operations (writes/deletes), link\n// partitions and link heals, and stop conditions (max ticks or convergence).\npackage run\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"aesync/core\"\n\t\"aesync/node\"\n\t\"aesync/sim\"\n)\n\n// Scenario is the JSON run interface.\ntype Scenario struct {\n\tName    string `json:\"name\"`\n\tSeed    int64  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNodes   []string `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tLinks   []LinkSpec `json:\"links\"`\n\tProtocol node.Config `json:\"protocol\"`\n\n\t// Initial data installed before time starts.\n\tInitial InitialData `json:\"initial\"`\n\n\t// Schedule of events at absolute simulated times (ms).\n\tSchedule []ScheduledEvent `json:\"schedule\"`\n\n\t// Stop conditions.\n\tMaxTicks int   `json:\"max_ticks\"`\n\tMaxTimeMS int64 `json:\"max_time_ms\"`\n\tStopOnConverged bool `json:\"stop_on_converged\"`\n\t// ConvergeCheckAfterTicks skips convergence checks during early churn.\n\tConvergeCheckAfterTicks int64 `json:\"converge_check_after_ticks\"`\n}\n\n// LinkSpec declares one undirected link.\ntype LinkSpec struct {\n\tA string         `json:\"a\"`\n\tB string         `json:\"b\"`\n\tCfg sim.LinkConfig `json:\"cfg\"`\n}\n\n// InitialData seeds stores.\ntype InitialData struct {\n\t// Entries replicated onto ALL nodes (shared identical keyspace).\n\tShared []SeedEntry `json:\"shared\"`\n\t// PerNode entries installed only on one node.\n\tPerNode map[string][]SeedEntry `json:\"per_node\"`\n}\n\n// SeedEntry is an initial record with an explicit version for determinism.\ntype SeedEntry struct {\n\tKey     string `json:\"key\"`\n\tValue   string `json:\"value\"`\n\tDeleted bool   `json:\"deleted\"`\n\t// Seq defaults to a 1..n assignment per origin when zero.\n\tSeq int64 `json:\"seq\"`\n}\n\n// ScheduledEvent mutates the world at a fixed simulated time.\ntype ScheduledEvent struct {\n\tAtMS int64 `json:\"at_ms\"`\n\t// one of:\n\tWrite  *ClientWrite `json:\"write,omitempty\"`\n\tDelete *ClientDelete `json:\"delete,omitempty\"`\n\tPartition *LinkToggle `json:\"partition,omitempty\"`\n\tHeal      *LinkToggle `json:\"heal,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// ClientWrite writes a value on Node using that node's logical clock.\ntype ClientWrite struct {\n\tNode  string `json:\"node\"`\n\tKey   string `json:\"key\"`\n\tValue string `json:\"value\"`\n}\n\n// ClientDelete tombstones a key on Node.\ntype ClientDelete struct {\n\tNode string `json:\"node\"`\n\tKey  string `json:\"key\"`\n}\n\n// LinkToggle partitions/heals the link between A and B. Partition UntilMS=0\n// means \"down until an explicit heal\".\ntype LinkToggle struct {\n\tA string `json:\"a\"`\n\tB string `json:\"b\"`\n\tUntilMS int64 `json:\"until_ms\"`\n}\n\n// LoadScenario reads and validates a scenario file.\nfunc LoadScenario(path string) (*Scenario, error) {\n\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tvar s Scenario\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &s); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"parse scenario: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif err := s.validate(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn &s, nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *Scenario) validate() error {\n\tif len(s.Nodes) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scenario needs at least one node\")\n\t}\n\tknown := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, id := range s.Nodes {\n\t\tif known[id] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"duplicate node %q\", id)\n\t\t}\n\t\tknown[id] = true\n\t}\n\tfor _, l := range s.Links {\n\t\tif !known[l.A] || !known[l.B] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"link references unknown node: %s-%s\", l.A, l.B)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif s.MaxTicks == 0 && s.MaxTimeMS == 0 {\n\t\ts.MaxTicks = 100\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Report is the JSON result of a run.\ntype Report struct {\n\tScenario string `json:\"scenario\"`\n\tSeed     int64  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tConverged bool `json:\"converged\"`\n\tConvergedAtMS int64 `json:\"converged_at_ms\"`\n\tEndTimeMS int64 `json:\"end_time_ms\"`\n\tTicks     int64 `json:\"ticks\"`\n\tCounters  node.Counters `json:\"counters\"`\n\tLinks     map[string]sim.LinkStats `json:\"links\"`\n\tNodes     map[string]NodeState `json:\"nodes\"`\n}\n\n// NodeState is the per-node final view in the report.\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tLiveKeys   int `json:\"live_keys\"`\n\tTombstones int `json:\"tombstones\"`\n\tLogTotal   int `json:\"log_total\"`\n}\n\n// Runner holds the constructed simulation.\ntype Runner struct {\n\tsc    *Scenario\n\tnet   *sim.Network\n\tnodes map[string]*node.Node\n\tcnt   *node.Counters\n\tticks int64\n}\n\n// New constructs all nodes and installs initial data and the schedule.\nfunc New(sc *Scenario) *Runner {\n\tnet := sim.NewNetwork(sc.Seed)\n\tnet.MaxTimeMS = sc.MaxTimeMS\n\tcnt := &node.Counters{}\n\tr := &Runner{sc: sc, net: net, nodes: map[string]*node.Node{}, cnt: cnt}\n\n\tstores := map[string]*core.Store{}\n\tfor _, id := range sc.Nodes {\n\t\tst := core.NewStore(id)\n\t\tstores[id] = st\n\t\tn := node.New(id, st, sc.Protocol, net, cnt)\n\t\tn.SetPeers(sc.Nodes)\n\t\tr.nodes[id] = n\n\t}\n\tfor _, l := range sc.Links {\n\t\tnet.SetLink(l.A, l.B, l.Cfg)\n\t}\n\n\tr.seedData(stores)\n\tr.scheduleEvents()\n\treturn r\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) seedData(stores map[string]*core.Store) {\n\t// Shared entries get per-origin versions so every node starts identical.\n\tsharedByOrigin := map[string][]core.Entry{}\n\torigin := firstNode(r.sc.Nodes)\n\tseq := int64(0)\n\tfor _, e := range r.sc.Initial.Shared {\n\t\tseq++\n\t\tv := e.Seq\n\t\tif v == 0 {\n\t\t\tv = seq\n\t\t}\n\t\ten := core.Entry{\n\t\t\tKey: e.Key, Value: []byte(e.Value), Deleted: e.Deleted,\n\t\t\tVersion: core.Version{Seq: v, Origin: origin},\n\t\t}\n\t\tsharedByOrigin[origin] = append(sharedByOrigin[origin], en)\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range r.sc.Nodes {\n\t\tfor _, en := range sharedByOrigin[origin] {\n\t\t\tstores[id].PutSeeded(en)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor id, seeds := range r.sc.Initial.PerNode {\n\t\tst, ok := stores[id]\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i, e := range seeds {\n\t\t\tv := e.Seq\n\t\t\tif v == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tv = int64(i + 1)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tst.PutSeeded(core.Entry{\n\t\t\t\tKey: e.Key, Value: []byte(e.Value), Deleted: e.Deleted,\n\t\t\t\tVersion: core.Version{Seq: v, Origin: id},\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc firstNode(nodes []string) string {\n\tif len(nodes) == 0 {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn nodes[0]\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) scheduleEvents() {\n\t// Gossip ticks for every node at the cadence, phase-aligned but\n\t// interleaved by node id order.\n\ttick := r.sc.Protocol.TickIntervalMS\n\tif tick <= 0 {\n\t\ttick = 100\n\t}\n\tmaxTicks := r.sc.MaxTicks\n\tif maxTicks <= 0 {\n\t\tmaxTicks = *Scenario) validate() error {\n\tif len(s.Nodes) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scenario needs at least one node\")\n\t}\n\tknown := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, id := range s.Nodes {\n\t\tif known[id] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"duplicate node %q\", id)\n\t\t}\n\t\tknown[id] = true\n\t}\n\tfor _, l := range s.Links {\n\t\tif !known[l.A] || !known[l.B] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"link references unknown node: %s-%s\", l.A, l.B)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif s.MaxTicks == 0 && s.MaxTimeMS == 0 {\n\t\ts.MaxTicks = 100\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Report is the JSON result of a run.\ntype Report {\n\t\t\t\t\tr.convergedAt = now\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tr.net.Run(func(nextAt int64) bool {\n\t\tr.ticks = nextAt / tickInterval\n\t\tif r.convergedAt > 0 && nextAt >= r.convergedAt {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t})\n\n\treturn r.buildReport()\n}\n\tvar m int64\n\tfor _, l := range sc.Links {\n\t\tif l.Cfg.MaxLatencyMS > m {\n\t\t\tm = report.\n//\n// A scenario declares nodes, their initial data, link fault profiles, the\n// protocol config, a schedule of client operations (writes/deletes), link\n// partitions and link heals, and stop conditions (max ticks or convergence).\npackage run\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"aesync/core\"\n\t\"aesync/node\"\n\t\"aesync/sim\"\n)\n\n// Scenario is the JSON run interface.\ntype Scenario struct {\n\tName    string `json:\"name\"`\n\tSeed    int64  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNodes   []string `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tLinks   []LinkSpec `json:\"links\"`\n\tProtocol node.Config `json:\"protocol\"`\n\n\t// Initial data installed before time starts.\n\tInitial InitialData `json:\"initial\"`\n\n\t// Schedule of events at absolute simulated times (ms).\n\tSchedule []ScheduledEvent `json:\"schedule\"`\n\n\t// Stop conditions.\n\tMaxTicks int   `json:\"max_ticks\"`\n\tMaxTimeMS int64 `json:\"max_time_ms\"`\n\tStopOnConverged bool `json:\"stop_on_converged\"`\n\t// ConvergeCheckAfterTicks skips convergence checks during early churn.\n\tConvergeCheckAfterTicks int64 `json:\"converge_check_after_ticks\"`\n}\n\n// LinkSpec declares one undirected link.\ntype LinkSpec struct {\n\tA string         `json:\"a\"`\n\tB string         `json:\"b\"`\n\tCfg sim.LinkConfig `json:\"cfg\"`\n}\n\n// InitialData seeds stores.\ntype InitialData struct {\n\t// Entries replicated onto ALL nodes (shared identical keyspace).\n\tShared []SeedEntry `json:\"shared\"`\n\t// PerNode entries installed only on one node.\n\tPerNode map[string][]SeedEntry `json:\"per_node\"`\n}\n\n// SeedEntry is an initial record with an explicit version for determinism.\ntype SeedEntry struct {\n\tKey     string `json:\"key\"`\n\tValue   string `json:\"value\"`\n\tDeleted bool   `json:\"deleted\"`\n\t// Seq defaults to a 1..n assignment per origin when zero.\n\tSeq int64 `json:\"seq\"`\n}\n\n// ScheduledEvent mutates the world at a fixed simulated time.\ntype ScheduledEvent struct {\n\tAtMS int64 `json:\"at_ms\"`\n\t// one of:\n\tWrite  *ClientWrite `json:\"write,omitempty\"`\n\tDelete *ClientDelete `json:\"delete,omitempty\"`\n\tPartition *LinkToggle `json:\"partition,omitempty\"`\n\tHeal      *LinkToggle `json:\"heal,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// ClientWrite writes a value on Node using that node's logical clock.\ntype ClientWrite struct {\n\tNode  string `json:\"node\"`\n\tKey   string `json:\"key\"`\n\tValue string `json:\"value\"`\n}\n\n// ClientDelete tombstones a key on Node.\ntype ClientDelete struct {\n\tNode string `json:\"node\"`\n\tKey  string `json:\"key\"`\n}\n\n// LinkToggle partitions/heals the link between A and B. Partition UntilMS=0\n// means \"down until an explicit heal\".\ntype LinkToggle struct {\n\tA string `json:\"a\"`\n\tB string `json:\"b\"`\n\tUntilMS int64 `json:\"until_ms\"`\n}\n\n// LoadScenario reads and validates a scenario file.\nfunc LoadScenario(path string) (*Scenario, error) {\n\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tvar s Scenario\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &s); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"parse scenario: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif err := s.validate(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn &s, nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *Scenario) validate() error {\n\tif len(s.Nodes) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scenario needs at least one node\")\n\t}\n\tknown := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, id := range s.Nodes {\n\t\tif known[id] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"duplicate node %q\", id)\n\t\t}\n\t\tknown[id] = true\n\t}\n\tfor _, l := range s.Links {\n\t\tif !known[l.A] || !known[l.B] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"link references unknown node: %s-%s\", l.A, l.B)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif s.MaxTicks == 0 && s.MaxTimeMS == 0 {\n\t\ts.MaxTicks = 100\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Report is the JSON result of a run.\ntype Report struct {\n\tScenario string `json:\"scenario\"`\n\tSeed     int64  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tConverged bool `json:\"converged\"`\n\tConvergedAtMS int64 `json:\"converged_at_ms\"`\n\tEndTimeMS int64 `json:\"end_time_ms\"`\n\tTicks     int64 `json:\"ticks\"`\n\tCounters  node.Counters `json:\"counters\"`\n\tLinks     map[string]sim.LinkStats `json:\"links\"`\n\tNodes     map[string]NodeState `json:\"nodes\"`\n}\n\n// NodeState is the per-node final view in the report.\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tLiveKeys   int `json:\"live_keys\"`\n\tTombstones int `json:\"tombstones\"`\n\tLogTotal   int err != nil {\n\t\t\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"write report: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\t\tos.Exit(1)\n\t\t}\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"report written to %s (converged=%v at t=%dms)\\n\",\n\t\t\t*outPath, rep.Converged, rep.ConvergedAtMS)\n\t} else {\n\t\tos.Stdout.Write(data)\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"17c58ba9-b3d9-47e8-90ea-948c6b9fad68","session_id":"6ceb46e9-51b0-4732-85e2-22ec4d062a75","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp25/b","sessionId":"6ceb46e9-51b0-4732-85e2-22ec4d062a75","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp25-b","slug":"happy-sleeping-aurora"}

(\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"aesync/core\"\n\t\"aesync/node\"\n\t\"aesync/sim\"\n)\n\n// Scenario is the JSON run interface.\ntype Scenario struct {\n\tName    string `json:\"name\"`\n\tSeed    int64  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNodes   []string `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tLinks   []LinkSpec `json:\"links\"`\n\tProtocol node.Config `json:\"protocol\"`\n\n\t// Initial data installed before time starts.\n\tInitial InitialData `json:\"initial\"`\n\n\t// Schedule of events at absolute simulated times (ms).\n\tSchedule []ScheduledEvent `json:\"schedule\"`\n\n\t// Stop conditions.\n\tMaxTicks int   `json:\"max_ticks\"`\n\tMaxTimeMS int64 `json:\"max_time_ms\"`\n\tStopOnConverged bool `json:\"stop_on_converged\"`\n\t// ConvergeCheckAfterTicks skips convergence checks during early churn.\n\tConvergeCheckAfterTicks int64 `json:\"converge_check_after_ticks\"`\n}\n\n// LinkSpec declares one undirected link.\ntype LinkSpec struct {\n\tA string         `json:\"a\"`\n\tB string         `json:\"b\"`\n\tCfg sim.LinkConfig `json:\"cfg\"`\n}\n\n// InitialData seeds stores.\ntype InitialData struct {\n\t// Entries replicated onto ALL nodes (shared identical keyspace).\n\tShared []SeedEntry `json:\"shared\"`\n\t// PerNode entries installed only on one node.\n\tPerNode map[string][]SeedEntry `json:\"per_node\"`\n}\n\n// SeedEntry is an initial record with an explicit version for determinism.\ntype SeedEntry struct {\n\tKey     string `json:\"key\"`\n\tValue   string `json:\"value\"`\n\tDeleted bool   `json:\"deleted\"`\n\t// Seq defaults to a 1..n assignment per origin when zero.\n\tSeq int64 `json:\"seq\"`\n}\n\n// ScheduledEvent mutates the world at a fixed simulated time.\ntype ScheduledEvent struct {\n\tAtMS int64 `json:\"at_ms\"`\n\t// one of:\n\tWrite  *ClientWrite `json:\"write,omitempty\"`\n\tDelete *ClientDelete `json:\"delete,omitempty\"`\n\tPartition *LinkToggle `json:\"partition,omitempty\"`\n\tHeal      *LinkToggle `json:\"heal,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// ClientWrite writes a value on Node using that node's logical clock.\ntype ClientWrite struct {\n\tNode  string `json:\"node\"`\n\tKey   string `json:\"key\"`\n\tValue string `json:\"value\"`\n}\n\n// ClientDelete tombstones a key on Node.\ntype ClientDelete struct {\n\tNode string `json:\"node\"`\n\tKey  string `json:\"key\"`\n}\n\n// LinkToggle partitions/heals the link between A and B. Partition UntilMS=0\n// means \"down until an explicit heal\".\ntype LinkToggle struct {\n\tA string `json:\"a\"`\n\tB string `json:\"b\"`\n\tUntilMS int64 `json:\"until_ms\"`\n}\n\n// LoadScenario reads and validates a scenario file.\nfunc LoadScenario(path string) (*Scenario, error) {\n\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tvar s Scenario\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &s); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"parse scenario: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif err := s.validate(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn &s, nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *Scenario) validate() error {\n\tif len(s.Nodes) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scenario needs at least one node\")\n\t}\n\tknown := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, id := range s.Nodes {\n\t\tif known[id] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"duplicate node %q\", id)\n\t\t}\n\t\tknown[id] = true\n\t}\n\tfor _, l := range s.Links {\n\t\tif !known[l.A] || !known[l.B] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"link references unknown node: %s-%s\", l.A, l.B)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif s.MaxTicks == 0 && s.MaxTimeMS == 0 {\n\t\ts.MaxTicks = 100\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Report is the JSON result of a run.\ntype Report struct {\n\tScenario string `json:\"scenario\"`\n\tSeed     int64  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tConverged bool `json:\"converged\"`\n\tConvergedAtMS int64 `json:\"converged_at_ms\"`\n\tEndTimeMS int64 `json:\"end_time_ms\"`\n\tTicks     int64 `json:\"ticks\"`\n\tCounters  node.Counters `json:\"counters\"`\n\tLinks     map[string]sim.LinkStats `json:\"links\"`\n\tNodes     map[string]NodeState `json:\"nodes\"`\n}\n\n// NodeState is the per-node final view in the report.\ntype NodeState struct {\n\tLiveKeys   int `json:\"live_keys\"`\n\tTombstones int `json:\"tombstones\"`\n\tLogTotal   int `json:\"log_total\"`\n}\n\n// Runner holds the constructed simulation.\ntype Runner struct {\n\tsc          *Scenario\n\tnet         *sim.Network\n\tnodes       map[string]*node.Node\n\tcnt         *node.Counters\n\tticks       int64\n\tconvergedAt int64\n}\n\n// New constructs all nodes and installs initial data and the schedule.\nfunc New(sc *Scenario) *Runner {\n\tnet := sim.NewNetwork(sc.Seed)\n\tnet.MaxTimeMS = sc.MaxTimeMS\n\tcnt := &node.Counters{}\n\tr := &Runner{sc: sc, net: net, nodes: map[string]*node.Node{}, cnt: cnt, convergedAt: -1}\n\n\tstores := map[string]*core.Store{}\n\tfor _, id := range sc.Nodes {\n\t\tst := core.NewStore(id)\n\t\tstores[id] = st\n\t\tn := node.New(id, st, sc.Protocol, net, cnt)\n\t\tn.SetPeers(sc.Nodes)\n\t\tr.nodes[id] = n\n\t}\n\tfor _, l := range sc.Links {\n\t\tnet.SetLink(l.A, l.B, l.Cfg)\n\t}\n\n\tr.seedData(stores)\n\tr.scheduleEvents()\n\treturn r\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) seedData(stores map[string]*core.Store) {\n\t// Shared entries get per-origin versions so every node starts identical.\n\tsharedByOrigin := map[string][]core.Entry{}\n\torigin := firstNode(r.sc.Nodes)\n\tseq := int64(0)\n\tfor _, e := range r.sc.Initial.Shared {\n\t\tseq++\n\t\tv := e.Seq\n\t\tif v == 0 {\n\t\t\tv = seq\n\t\t}\n\t\ten := core.Entry{\n\t\t\tKey: e.Key, Value: []byte(e.Value), Deleted: e.Deleted,\n\t\t\tVersion: core.Version{Seq: v, Origin: origin},\n\t\t}\n\t\tsharedByOrigin[origin] = append(sharedByOrigin[origin], en)\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range r.sc.Nodes {\n\t\tfor _, en := range sharedByOrigin[origin] {\n\t\t\tstores[id].PutSeeded(en)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor id, seeds := range r.sc.Initial.PerNode {\n\t\tst, ok := stores[id]\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor i, e := range seeds {\n\t\t\tv := e.Seq\n\t\t\tif v == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tv = int64(i + 1)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tst.PutSeeded(core.Entry{\n\t\t\t\tKey: e.Key, Value: []byte(e.Value), Deleted: e.Deleted,\n\t\t\t\tVersion: core.Version{Seq: v, Origin: id},\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc firstNode(nodes []string) string {\n\tif len(nodes) == 0 {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn nodes[0]\n}\n\nfunc (r *Runner) scheduleEvents() {\n\t// Gossip ticks for every node at the cadence, phase-aligned but\n\t// interleaved by node id order.\n\ttick := r.sc.Protocol.TickIntervalMS\n\tif tick <= 0 {\n\t\ttick = 100\n\t}\n\tmaxTicks := r.sc.MaxTicks\n\tif maxTicks <= 0 {\n\t\tmaxTicks = 100\n\t}\n\tfor _, id := range r.sc.Nodes {\n\t\tn := r.nodes[id]\n\t\tfor k := int64(0); k < maxTicks; k++ {\n\t\t\tt := tick*(k+1) + (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"aesync/core\"\n\t\"aesync/node\"\n\t\"aesync/sim\"\n)\n\n// Scenario is the JSON run interface.\ntype Scenario struct {\n\tName    string `json:\"name\"`\n\tSeed    int64  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNodes   []string `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tLinks   []LinkSpec `json:\"links\"`\n\tProtocol node.Config `json:\"protocol\"`\n\n\t// Initial data installed before time starts.\n\tInitial InitialData `json:\"initial\"`\n\n\t// Schedule of events at absolute simulated times (ms).\n\tSchedule []ScheduledEvent `json:\"schedule\"`\n\n\t// Stop conditions.\n\tMaxTicks int   `json:\"max_ticks\"`\n\tMaxTimeMS int64 `json:\"max_time_ms\"`\n\tStopOnConverged bool `json:\"stop_on_converged\"`\n\t// ConvergeCheckAfterTicks skips convergence checks during early churn.\n\tConvergeCheckAfterTicks int64 `json:\"converge_check_after_ticks\"`\n}\n\n// LinkSpec declares one undirected link.\ntype LinkSpec struct {\n\tA string         `json:\"a\"`\n\tB string         `json:\"b\"`\n\tCfg sim.LinkConfig `json:\"cfg\"`\n}\n\n// InitialData seeds stores.\ntype InitialData struct {\n\t// Entries replicated onto ALL nodes (shared identical keyspace).\n\tShared []SeedEntry `json:\"shared\"`\n\t// PerNode entries installed only on one node.\n\tPerNode map[string][]SeedEntry `json:\"per_node\"`\n}\n\n// SeedEntry is an initial record with This avoids\n// probing in the middle of a request/reply exchange, when sessions are\n// legitimately \"in flight\".\nfunc (r *Runner) Run() *Report {\n\ttickInterval := r.sc.Protocol.TickIntervalMS\n\tif tickInterval <= 0 {\n\t\ttickInterval = 100\n\t}\n\tmaxTicks := int64(r.sc.MaxTicks)\n\tif maxTicks <= 0 {\n\t\tmaxTicks = 100\n\t}\n\tchurnUntilTick := r.sc.ConvergeCheckAfterTicks\n\tsettle := maxLatency(r.sc) + 2\n\n\tprobeScheduled := false\n\tvar scheduleProbe func()\n\tscheduleProbe = func() {\n\t\tif !r.sc.StopOnConverged || probeScheduled || r.convergedAt >= 0 {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.net.Now() < tickInterval*churnUntilTick {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tprobeScheduled = true\n\t\tat := r.net.Now() + settle\n\t\tr.net.ScheduleFunc(\"converge-probe\", at, func(now int64) {\n\t\t\tprobeScheduled = false\n\t\t\tif r.convergedAt >= 0 {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif r.net.Pending() == 0 && r.allIdle() && r.logsEqual() {\n\t\t\t\tr.convergedAt = now\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// Messages appeared while waiting: re-arm after the next drain.\n\t\t\tif r.net.Pending() > 0 {\n\t\t\t\tscheduleProbe()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\tr.net.Run(func(nextAt int64) bool {\n\t\tr.ticks = nextAt / tickInterval\n\t\tif r.convergedAt > 0 && nextAt >= r.convergedAt {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t})\n\n\t// Arm a post-drain probe after each step by polling pending count. The\n\t// network exposes no hook, so we drive it from a second light pass:\n\t// instead, check immediately when the run loop observes pending==0.\n\t_ = scheduleProbe\n\treturn r.buildReport()\n}\n"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_a32b1151b9bf792bb1a1e749","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1789,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":96056,"output_tokens":1068,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_cxp2b31msexr220o4sxqge34":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp25/b/run/scenario.go","new_string":"// Run executes the simulation to completion and returns the report.\n//\n// Convergence detection: once the churn phase is over, every time the message\n// queue drains to empty we schedule one probe a short settle window later. Nodes communicate by\n// scheduling MessageEvents; user code can schedule FuncEvents (gossip ticks,\n// client writes, link partitions, link healing). Per-link behaviour —\n// latency, loss, duplication, reordering — is driven by a seeded RNG so a run\n// is fully reproducible from its JSON scenario.\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"container/heap\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n)\n\n// Event is anything the clock can deliver.\ntype Event interface {\n\tAt() int64\n\tsetAt(int64)\n\tkindTag() string\n}\n\n// baseEvent carries heap bookkeeping.\ntype baseEvent struct {\n\tat int64\n\t// index lets heap.Fix/Remove work.\n\tindex int\n\t// seq ties equal timestamps apart deterministically (insertion order).\n\tseq uint64\n}\n\nfunc (e *baseEvent) At() int64      { return e.at }\nfunc (e *baseEvent) setAt(t int64)  { e.at = t }\nfunc (e *baseEvent) kindTag() string { return \"\" }\nfunc (e *baseEvent) seqVal() uint64 { return e.seq }\n\n// MessageEvent is a network message reaching dst.\ntype MessageEvent struct {\n\tbaseEvent\n\tDst  string\n\tSize int64\n\t// Deliver hands the message to the destination node. It is an opaque\n\t// closure over the proto message so sim stays protocol-agnostic.\n\tDeliver func(now int64)\n\tTag     string\n}\n\nfunc (e *MessageEvent) kindTag() string { return \"msg:\" + e.Tag }\n\n// FuncEvent is a scheduled node/action callback.\ntype FuncEvent struct {\n\tbaseEvent\n\tName string\n\tF    func(now int64)\n}\n\nfunc (e *FuncEvent) kindTag() string { return \"func:\" + e.Name }\n\n// eventHeap orders events by (time, insertion sequence).\ntype eventHeap []Event\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\ta, b := h[i].At(), h[j].At()\n\tif a != b {\n\t\treturn a < b\n\t}\n\treturn seqOf(h[i]) < seqOf(h[j])\n}\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any)   { *h = append(*h, x.(Event)) }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\tx := old[n-1]\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn x\n}\n\n// seqProvider exposes the embedded baseEvent's tie-break sequence.\ntype seqProvider interface{ seqVal() uint64 }\n\nfunc seqOf(e Event) uint64 {\n\tif s, ok := e.(seqProvider); ok {\n\t\treturn s.seqVal()\n\t}\n\treturn 0\n}\n\n// LinkConfig describes one directed-ish link's fault profile. The same config\n// applies both ways (undirected edges), matching the partition model.\ntype LinkConfig struct {\n\tMinLatencyMS int64 `json:\"min_latency_ms\"`\n\tMaxLatencyMS int64 `json:\"max_latency_ms\"`\n\t// LossPct in [0,100]: probability a message copy is dropped.\n\tLossPct float64 `json:\"loss_pct\"`\n\t// DuplicatePct: probability an extra copy is scheduled.\n\tDuplicatePct float64 `json:\"duplicate_pct\"`\n\t// ReorderPct: probability a message is delayed one extra latency window,\n\t// which (combined with independent latencies) yields overtaking.\n\tReorderPct float64 `json:\"reorder_pct\"`\n}\n\n// LinkStats records traffic on one undirected link.\ntype LinkStats struct {\n\tSent      int64 `json:\"sent\"`\n\tDelivered int64 `json:\"delivered\"`\n\tLost      int64 `json:\"lost\"`\n\tDuplicated int64 `json:\"duplicated\"`\n\tBytesSent      int64 `json:\"bytes_sent\"`\n\tBytesDelivered int64 `json:\"bytes_delivered\"`\n}\n\n// Network is the simulator's clock + links.\ntype Network struct {\n\trng       *rand.Rand\n\tevents    eventHeap\n\tnow       int64\n\tnextSeq   uint64\n\tlinks     map[string]LinkConfig\n\tdownUntil map[string]int64 // undirected pair -> down until this time (-1 forever)\n\tstats     map[string]*LinkStats\n\t// pending counts messages in flight, useful for convergence gating.\n\tpending int\n\n\t// receivers maps node id to its inbound message handler.\n\treceivers map[string]func(tag string, payload []byte)\n\n\t// MaxTimeMS bounds a run defensively (0 = unlimited).\n\tMaxTimeMS int64\n}\n\n// NewNetwork creates a simulator seeded deterministically.\nfunc NewNetwork(seed int64) *Network {\n\tn := &Network{\n\t\trng:       rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)),\n\t\tlinks:     map[string]LinkConfig{},\n\t\tdownUntil: map[string]int64{},\n\t\tstats:     map[string]*LinkStats{},\n\t\treceivers: map[string]func(tag string, payload []byte){},\n\t}\n\tn.events = eventHeap{}\n\theap.Init(&n.events)\n\treturn n\n}\n\n// RegisterReceiver binds a node id to its inbound handler.\nfunc (n *Network) RegisterReceiver(id string, recv func(tag string, payload []byte)) {\n\tn.receivers[id] = recv\n}\n\n// SetLink registers an undirected link between a and b.\nfunc (n *Network) SetLink(a, b string, cfg LinkConfig) {\n\tn.links[pairKey(a, b)] = cfg\n}\n\n// Partition marks the link down until at least t (t <= 0 means forever).\nfunc (n *Network) Partition(a, b string, until int64) {\n\tn.downUntil[pairKey(a, b)] = until\n}\n\n// Heal brings the link back immediately.\nfunc (n *Network) Heal(a, b string) {\n\tdelete(n.downUntil, pairKey(a, b))\n}\n\n// IsDown reports the current link state.\nfunc (n *Network) IsDown(a, b string) bool {\n\tif t, ok := n.downUntil[pairKey(a, b)]; ok {\n\t\treturn t <= 0 || n.now < t\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// Now returns the simulated time in ms.\nfunc (n *Network) Now() int64 { return n.now }\n\n// Pending reports messages currently queued for delivery.\nfunc (n *Network) Pending() int { return n.pending }\n\nfunc pairKey(a, b string) string {\n\tif a < b {\n\t\treturn a + \"\\x00\" + b\n\t}\n\treturn b + \"\\x00\" + a\n}\n\nfunc (n *Network) stat(a, b string) *LinkStats {\n\tk := pairKey(a, b)\n\ts := n.stats[k]\n\tif s == nil {\n\t\ts = &LinkStats{}\n\t\tn.stats[k] = s\n\t}\n\treturn s\n}\n\n// Stats returns a snapshot of per-link counters.\nfunc (n *Network) Stats() map[string]LinkStats {\n\tout := make(map[string]LinkStats, len(n.stats))\n\tfor k, s := range n.stats {\n\t\tout[k] = *s\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// ScheduleFunc runs f at simulated time t.\nfunc (n *Network) ScheduleFunc(name string, t int64, f func(now int64)) {\n\tev := &FuncEvent{Name: name, F: f}\n\tn.nextSeq++\n\tev.baseEvent.seq = n.nextSeq\n\tev.setAt(t)\n\theap.Push(&n.events, ev)\n}\n\n// Send schedules the delivery of one JSON message from src to dst according to\n// the link fault profile. Duplicates, loss and reordering are decided per\n// copy. On delivery the dst-registered receiver is invoked with the payload.\nfunc (n *Network) Send(src, dst, tag string, payload []byte) {\n\tsize := int64(len(payload))\n\tst := n.stat(src, dst)\n\tst.Sent++\n\tst.BytesSent += size\n\tn.pending++\n\n\tcfg := n.links[pairKey(src, dst)]\n\n\t// One \"original\" copy plus maybe a duplicate.\n\tn.scheduleCopy(src, dst, tag, payload, size, cfg, st)\n\tif cfg.DuplicatePct > 0 && n.rng.Float64()*100 < cfg.DuplicatePct {\n\t\tst.Duplicated++\n\t\tn.scheduleCopy(src, dst, tag, payload, size, cfg, st)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Network) scheduleCopy(src, dst, tag string, payload []byte, size int64,\n\tcfg LinkConfig, st *LinkStats) {\n\n\tif n.IsDown(src, dst) {\n\t\tst.Lost++\n\t\tn.pending--\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif cfg.LossPct > 0 && n.rng.Float64()*100 < cfg.LossPct {\n\t\tst.Lost++\n\t\tn.pending--\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tlat := cfg.MinLatencyMS\n\tif cfg.MaxLatencyMS > lat {\n\t\tlat += n.rng.Int63n(cfg.MaxLatencyMS - lat + 1)\n\t}\n\tif lat < 0 {\n\t\tlat = 0\n\t}\n\tif cfg.ReorderPct > 0 && n.rng.Float64()*100 < cfg.ReorderPct {\n\t\t// Push this copy late enough that later-sent messages overtake it.\n\t\tlat += cfg.MaxLatencyMS + 1\n\t}\n\tat := n.now + lat\n\tev := &MessageEvent{Dst: dst, Size: size, Tag: tag}\n\tn.nextSeq++\n\tev.baseEvent.seq = n.nextSeq\n\tbody := append([]byte(nil), payload...)\n\tev.Deliver = func(now int64) {\n\t\t// A link may fail while the message is in flight: re-check on delivery.\n\t\tif n.IsDown(src, dst) {\n\t\t\tst.Lost++\n\t\t\tn.pending--\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tst.Delivered++\n\t\tst.BytesDelivered += size\n\t\tn.pending--\n\t\tif recv := n.receivers[dst]; recv != nil {\n\t\t\trecv(tag, body)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tev.setAt(at)\n\theap.Push(&n.events, ev)\n}\n\n// Step advances one event. It returns false when no events remain (or the\n// defensive time bound is hit).\nfunc (n *Network) Step() bool {\n\tif n.events.Len() == 0 {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tev := heap.Pop(&n.events).(Event)\n\tif n.MaxTimeMS > 0 && ev.At() > n.MaxTimeMS {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.now = ev.At()\n\tswitch e := ev.(type) {\n\tcase *MessageEvent:\n\t\te.Deliver(n.now)\n\tcase *FuncEvent:\n\t\te.F(n.now)\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// RunUntilIdle processes all events.\nfunc (n *Network) RunUntilIdle() {\n\tfor n.Step() {\n\t}\n}\n\n// Run processes events while cont() returns true (or until idle).\nfunc (n *Network) Run(cont func(now int64) bool) {\n\tfor n.events.Len() > 0 {\n\t\tpeek := n.events[0].At()\n\t\tif n.MaxTimeMS > 0 && peek > n.MaxTimeMS {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !cont(peek) {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.Step()\n\t}\n}\n\n// RNG exposes the deterministic stream for fault scheduling by callers.\nfunc (n *Network) RNG() *rand.Rand { return n.rng }\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":125,"oldLines":6,"newStart":125,"newLines":10,"lines":["   // receivers maps node id to its inbound message handler.","   receivers map[string]func(tag string, payload []byte)"," ","+  // DrainHook, if set, fires when the in-flight count transitions to zero.","+  // Callers may schedule new events from it (e.g. convergence probes).","+  DrainHook func()","+","   // MaxTimeMS bounds a run defensively (0 = unlimited).","   MaxTimeMS int64"," }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7a8e8cc2-a676-4d55-8e87-c58d989c9d7a","session_id":"6ceb46e9-51b0-4732-85e2-22ec4d062a75","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp25/b","sessionId":"6ceb46e9-51b0-4732-85e2-22ec4d062a75","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp25-b","slug":"happy-sleeping-aurora"}
